lines.t: (Verse 1)
I tried to do this on my own,
Make my own way, call it home,
But every road just felt the same,
Different choices, same old pain
I kept running, didn’t slow down,
Even when I knew I was worn out,
Then You met me where I stood—
Didn’t leave me like I thought You would
(Pre-Chorus)
Oh— I don’t wanna split my soul in two
Half for the world, half for You
No more almost, no in-between
You get all of me, every frequency
(Chorus)
I am Yours, Lord,
I am Yours.
I'm willing to be only Yours.
I love You so,
Love You so,
And I always will.
I love You.
And Lord this love is so true.
I am Yours, Lord.
I am Yours, Lord.
And I'm glad to be Yours.
(Verse 2)
You’re my truth when I start to doubt,
You’re my peace when I’m stressed out,
You’re the voice that pulls me back,
When I feel like I’m off track
You’re my reason I don’t give in,
You’re the strength underneath my skin,
I don’t have to figure it out—
You stay with me through it now
(Pre-Chorus 2 – adjusted)
Oh— every part of me is known by You
Even the things I try to hide from view
No more running, no disguise
I’m Yours in truth, not just in lines
(Chorus)
I am Yours, Lord,
I am Yours.
I'm willing to be only Yours.
I love You so,
Love You so,
And I always will.
I love You.
And Lord this love is so true.
I am Yours, Lord.
I am Yours, Lord.
And I'm glad to be Yours.
(Bridge – simpler, more honest, reflective)
I don’t need to understand it all,
I just know You won’t let me fall,
Even when my faith feels small—
You’re still there through it all
Take my plans, take my pride,
All the parts I used to hide,
I don’t want to hold them tight—
I’m letting go tonight
(Final Chorus)
I am Yours, Lord,
I am Yours.
I'm willing to be only Yours.
I love You so,
Love You so,
And I always will.
I love You.
And Lord this love is so true.
I am Yours, Lord.
I am Yours, Lord.
And I'm glad to be Yours.
